# Top Speed Appliance

> Top Speed Appliance LLC is an appliance repair, installation, sales and delivery company serving Florida's tri-county area (Broward, Palm Beach and Miami-Dade counties). topspeedappliance.net is a front door of the Top Speed Service OS — every booking lands in the same dispatch queue, with live tracking from request to repair. Slogan: "The Faster, The Better."

## Contact

- Phone: (844) 460-7038
- Office: 6810 N State Rd 7, Suite 341, Coconut Creek, FL 33073
- Hours: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 7:00 PM
- Website: https://topspeedappliance.net/
- Main platform: https://topspeedserviceos.com/

## Services

- Refrigerator repair
- Washer repair
- Dryer repair
- Oven and range repair
- Dishwasher repair
- Freezer and ice maker repair
- Microwave repair
- Garbage disposal repair
- Appliance installation

## Pricing (residential)

- Diagnostic: $99, collected at booking and credited toward an approved repair. The diagnostic is still due if the repair is declined.
- Repair labor: $210 flat.
- Installation labor: $150 flat.
- Parts and materials are priced in a written quote. No work is done without an approved written quote.
- Commercial service is priced by custom quote only — see Appliance Pro (https://www.appliancepro.net/).

## Coverage

- 65 cities across Broward (31), Palm Beach (16) and Miami-Dade (18) counties are matched automatically when booking; 104 city pages are published in total.
- Coverage directory: https://topspeedserviceos.com/service-areas-directory/

## Booking

- Book with Speedy, the AI service assistant on this site, or with the classic web form on the main platform: https://topspeedserviceos.com/book — the form is the primary booking path; Speedy summarizes and asks for confirmation before anything is sent to the office.
- Every job is confirmed by a human Service Setter and tracked live in Track My Tech.
- Refer & Earn program: https://topspeedserviceos.com/refer

## Network partner

- Cleanout Vents is the Top Speed network's registered partner for dryer vent cleaning, reachable through Top Speed at (844) 460-7038. Vent services are quoted by Cleanout Vents; Top Speed does not publish vent prices.
